name: sc5j
goal: Scenario 5 J (simple): label read; harness locates the cap (grid) -> WALLX prompt with its cell; WALLX does ALL the motion (110 calls, all cameras); the harness keeps watching: if the cap is moved to another cell (first 50 calls), the prompt is cancelled and WALLX gets a new one with the new location (history reset); release, home.
setup: Cap in the centre, label to the camera; trays in zones; arms at rest. Move the cap quickly while WALLX reaches for it.
